content.short: Steakhouse Financial is a leading DeFi risk curator and advisory firm specializing in institutional yield vaults.
content.description:
Steakhouse Financial is a premier crypto-native advisory and risk curation firm, dedicated to providing institutional-grade financial management for decentralized organizations. The firm specializes in curating "MetaMorpho" vaults on the Morpho protocol, managing billions in TVL across major networks including Ethereum, Base, and Solana. By conducting rigorous underwriting and risk assessment, Steakhouse provides DAOs like MakerDAO (Sky) and institutional investors with transparent and secure yield strategies backed by high-quality collateral.

Beyond vault curation, the firm offers comprehensive treasury management and research services for the decentralized economy. Steakhouse Financial focuses on professional-grade transparency and data-driven decision-making, serving as a vital bridge between traditional financial principles and decentralized technology. Through its commitment to secure and sustainable yield generation, the firm is empowering the next generation of digital asset managers to build and manage sophisticated decentralized portfolios with unparalleled confidence.
content.meta: Steakhouse Financial provides institutional DeFi risk curation and treasury management advisory across multiple chains.
